REQ-1.description: Create a bill by hand: add, edit and remove line items (name, quantity, unit price), with inline validation that never rounds typed money.

REQ-2.description: Add people: choose how many (1-20) and optionally name them; removing a person drops their assignments.

REQ-3.description: Assign each item to one or more people; shared items split equally by default, with custom integer shares.

REQ-4.description: Tax, tip/service and discount, each as an amount or a percentage of the items subtotal; tax and tip split proportionally to each person's subtotal or equally, discount proportionally.

REQ-5.description: Deterministic rounding: one documented rounding policy, a single exact allocation per bill, per-person totals always sum exactly to the bill total and each is within 1 cent of the exact share.

REQ-6.description: 'Who owes what' results: per-person total with an item breakdown that sums exactly, and who owes whom with one selectable payer.

REQ-7.description: Export or share the result as plain text copied to the clipboard.

REQ-8.description: Region setting: the user can change the locale (pt-PT, en-GB, en-US) and the currency (EUR, GBP, USD) used to enter and show amounts; default pt-PT/EUR; stored locally.

REQ-9.description: A good, simple root README.md (what project-W is, what works today, how to open or run it, roadmap and releases, privacy stance); app/README.md updated for M1.

REQ-10.description: A real 10+ item bill can be split between 3 people end to end, proven by an automated UI test and the functional-review checklist.
